title: Project Graph, Package Boundaries and Dependency Enforcement
objective: Classify every project with Nx-compatible tags, generate the project dependency graph, and reject forbidden dependency directions, circular package dependencies, deep/internal imports and public-entry-point bypasses, with negative tests proving each rejection.
